journey.name: pin attempts wipe gate
journey.description:
Verifies that running out of PIN attempts wipes the wallet behind a gate that a relaunch cannot get past: once the last attempt fails, no PIN pad or biometric prompt is shown until the wipe has finished, and a relaunch resumes the wipe instead of offering the PIN again.
Precondition: a disposable, unfunded dev wallet with the app PIN enabled (Settings > Security) and a known PIN, biometrics off, on the PIN pad after a relaunch. This deletes the wallet. Terminating the app while the gate shows only lands on a step if the wipe is still running. Killing it at each wipe step on a real device, and relaunching through the Recovery home-screen quick action, stay manual checks: the harness cannot trigger a quick action.

actions.action: Verify the PIN pad is visible (identifier "PinPad")
Enter a wrong PIN with the number pad keys (identifiers "N0" to "N9") until the last-attempt message (identifier "LastAttempt") is visible
Enter a wrong PIN once more
Verify the wipe gate is visible (identifier "WipeGate") and the PIN pad (identifier "PinPad") is not
Terminate the app with xcodebuildmcp and launch it again
Verify either the wipe gate (identifier "WipeGate") or wallet onboarding is visible, and the PIN pad (identifier "PinPad") is not
Wait for the wipe to finish and verify wallet onboarding is visible
